reason: The hypothesis proposes laser shock peening (LSP) to create a nanocrystalline surface layer with compressive residual stresses on TC4, an intervention not studied in any of the provided passages. While the individual mechanisms (grain refinement, compressive stress) are well-known, their combination via LSP on this specific alloy is not suggested or tested in the literature, making the core idea new.
